intro: Armed and Ready marks the culmination of forging a weapon specifically designed to strip away the unholy defenses of the necromancer Morbent Fel. Having secured Grimand Elmore's craft and a holy blessing, the adventurer carries Morbent's Bane back across the river to the vengeful Sven Yorgen in Duskwood.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is the weapon against the fiend of which you spoke. You're all ready, friend. Best of luck to you, and I look forward to your tale of glory!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, friend. You haven't been gone that long, but I see a fire in your eyes I did not see before.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, this will be proof against the fiend Morbent Fel! Well done!
You are ready. Morbent Fel will fall.
